metrics.accuracy_denominator: answered question events; unanswered items are not incorrect answers
metrics.quiz_score_denominator: all questions in a completed attempt, including unanswered items
metrics.recent_subject_window: most recent five deduplicated completed attempt records in the exact board and variant context
metrics.trend_comparison: recent five subject attempts versus the preceding five; change of at least 5 percentage points is improving or declining
metrics.unique_question_totals: not inferred from legacy summary rows without question identity

mixed_board_fixture.legacy_attribution: omitted from subject/topic comparisons and disclosed as unattributed; retained in overall history

readiness.indicator: practice coverage and observed performance; not mastery and not an examination pass probability
readiness.pool_availability: uses current board, candidate variant, canonical eligibility, quarantine and question-selection filters
readiness.no_pool_state: NO_ELIGIBLE_PRACTICE_POOL is separated from an unassessed learner subject

board_limits.CPA: blueprint weighting unavailable; no official percentages or pass threshold are inferred
board_limits.CSE_and_LET: candidate variant is required before exact pool coverage or subject starts are recommended

recovery_final_head_retest.variant_guard: PASS: LET without level and LET Secondary without registered specialization return VARIANT_REQUIRED; eligible subject pool counts remain null until the variant is valid.
recovery_final_head_retest.integrity: No production learner or canonical data mutations.
